scope_decisions: Definition particles have nominal, not adverbial/case-phrase attachment. Copular facts and commands remain separate canonical endings.
Explicit standalone 이란 gains a Copula-kind candidate without manufacturing a nominal or joining tokens; lexical/identity alternatives remain.
Conjectural 으리 is emitted only before the reviewed ending 란; existing 으리라/으리라고 bundles remain unchanged.
Command licenses permit honorific, not past/modal/retrospective recovery. Source 행복하란 prevents a blanket adjective-command ban. Broader lexical and mood constraints remain open.
Existing -답다 command restrictions remain under COV-020; conjectural/retrospective paths retain their spelling constraints.
No new auxiliary connector, implicit reporting verb, arbitrary quoted-clause attachment or contextual sense selection.
Twenty-six corpus gains are from definition/copular forms; command/retrospective/conjectural cases have separate source-backed synthetic evidence.
Independent Korean-language review and the rest of the inventory remain open.
